summary: Clean on the MEM dimension. variable.py is a pure-Python graph-orchestration layer (Namespace/Variable/Values/CompiledGraph/Graph) built entirely from stdlib (sys, warnings, abc, dataclasses, typing); it imports no numba, no numbox.utils.lowlevel/meminfo, and contains no @njit/@cfunc bodies, no NRT incref/decref, no raw pointers, no struct-by-value ABI, and no JIT-code-vs-data lifetime concerns.
